Hey, you're the Morning Brief agent. Ephratah just woke up after an insane overnight session building Mission Control. He doesn't remember everything that happened. Your job is to get him back up to speed and fix some bugs.

Your tasks:

1. WAKE-UP DOCUMENT: Read campaigns.json, findings.json, dispatch-home.json, and the coordinated-sprint/ directory. Produce a concise "Morning Brief" that covers:
   - What happened last night (key wins, key losses, what got built)
   - What agents ran and what they produced
   - PRIORITIZED remaining tasks (most important to least important, with reasoning)
   - What needs attention TODAY (P0s, Monday deadline items)
   - Any agents that are still running or finished overnight
   Write this to .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/morning-brief.md

2. FIX SCROLL BUG: The campaigns page remaining section scrolls back to top every 5 seconds because the auto-refresh re-renders. The retrospective section also disappears on refresh. Fix both in campaigns-page.html. The issue is that render() rebuilds everything on each poll. The retro should persist (it already has window._retroLoaded but it may be getting reset). The scroll position save/restore exists but remaining section may be losing position within the debrief scroll container.

3. UPDATE CAMPAIGN DEBRIEF: The wins/losses in campaigns.json are stale. Add Follow-Up sprint wins for agents that completed: Polisher (check what it produced), Retrospector (retrospective.md), Integrator (retrospective tab), Analyst (session analytics), Video Analyzer (transcript + analysis), Medic (health page), Findings Analyst (video-findings page). Read their output files to understand what each actually delivered.

4. REFRESH RETROSPECTIVE: The retrospective at coordinated-sprint/retrospective.md is from hours ago and doesn't cover the Follow-Up sprint. Update it with new findings, new post-mortems (PM007, PM008, PM009), and lessons from the follow-up agents.

5. IP SENSITIVITY: Add a finding about intellectual property awareness. Ephratah works at Microsoft. MC is personal IP, not work product. Any demo to teammates must be framed as personal experimentation. Add a dispatch task about consulting IP guidelines and ensuring MC stays clearly personal.

Read CLAUDE.md at C:\Users\ephra\phredomade\CLAUDE.md first.

Key files:
- .claude/agent-hub/campaigns.json (campaign data + debrief)
- .claude/agent-hub/campaigns-page.html (scroll/retro bugs)
- .claude/agent-hub/findings.json (all findings)
- .claude/agent-hub/dispatch-home.json (all tasks)
- .claude/agent-hub/coordinated-sprint/ (all agent outputs)
- .claude/agent-hub/server.js (if needed for route changes)

DON'T touch hook.js or prompt-hook.js.

Design rule: CLAUDE.md Rule #10 — every output must be human-centered and polished. The morning brief should be scannable in 2 minutes.

6. STARTER GUIDE: Create a lightweight "Getting Started with Mission Control" page at .claude/agent-hub/starter-guide.html, routed at /starter. This is for Ephratah's friend who wants to try MC. Keep it dead simple: what MC is (2 sentences), how to install it (clone repo, run server.js), what to look at first (Dashboard, Dispatch, Campaigns), and 3 things to try. NOT the full /why pitch. Just "here's how to get running in 5 minutes." Wire it in server.js at /starter.

Start by reading the key files, then produce the brief, then fix bugs.
